newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamaha forms Taiwan joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Yamaha forms Taiwan joint venture.

text.p: Leading Japanese musical instrument maker Yamaha Corp said on Thursday it had formed a fifty-fifty joint venture in Taipei to import and market musical instruments and multimedia-related products.
The firm was set up in late November and will start operations in January, it said.

The new company, named Yamaha KHS Music Co Ltd and capitalised at T$100 million or the equivalent of 400 million yen, is owned 50 percent by Yamaha and the rest by Kung Hsue She Trading Co Ltd (KHS), a Taiwan sales agent for Yamaha-made musical instruments.
The new company hopes to achieve sales of T$1.66 billion or 6.6 billion yen in the first year, and T$2 billion, or eight billion yen, in 1999.
